top_stories.title: SIR enumeration phase begins in Odisha, Mizoram, Sikkim and Manipur, says EC | Today News
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission** of India has commenced the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Odisha, Mizoram, Sikkim, and Manipur. The enumeration process involves Booth Level Officers (BLOs) visiting homes to collect and verify voter registration forms. Voters can submit their completed forms through BLOs or online.  Eligible voters must submit their forms by June 28th for inclusion in the draft electoral rolls. The **Election Commission** emphasizes that the SIR exercise aims to ensure accurate and comprehensive voter lists, including all eligible citizens aged 18 and above while removing ineligible individuals.

top_stories.title: Malta's Labour party wins historic fourth term amid Mideast crisis - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Robert Abela**, leader of the **Malta Labour Party**, secured an unprecedented fourth term in office after a snap election, winning against his main rival, Alex Borg of the Nationalist Party.  The victory comes amidst geopolitical uncertainties and concerns about the impact of the Middle East crisis on Malta's tourism industry.  **Abela** campaigned on his party's economic record since 2013, promising stability in a period of uncertainty. **Borg**, while conceding defeat, expressed congratulations to **Abela**. The election results reflect a strong economy and low unemployment rate, but also highlight concerns about population growth, environmental degradation, and climate change.

top_stories.title: Why India's Spot Electricity Prices Are Swinging Sharply This Summer
top_stories.rephrased_article: **India's** electricity spot prices have experienced sharp volatility this summer, with daytime prices plummeting to near-zero levels and surging to the regulatory ceiling of Rs 10 per unit (kWh) at night. This trend is attributed to a widening mismatch between supply and demand across different times of day, driven by abundant solar generation during daylight hours and elevated evening demand for cooling. Generators are selling electricity at low prices due to near-zero variable costs associated with solar power, while also managing excess generation from solar plants that may exceed scheduled deliveries.

top_stories.title: Nepal PM calls for dialogue with India to resolve border issues, seeks UK's involvement in talks - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nepal's** Prime Minister Balendra Shah called for dialogue and diplomatic efforts to resolve border disputes with **India**, proposing the involvement of the **United Kingdom**.  Shah cited Britain's role in shaping the region's modern borders during colonial times, arguing that the UK should be concerned about the unresolved issues. He stated that Nepal has exchanged diplomatic notes with **India** and agreed on a roadmap involving experts to examine historical records related to disputed territories.

top_stories.title: Mango cultivation a very special part of India's farm economy: PM | Today News
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** highlighted the importance of **mango** cultivation to India's agricultural economy during his monthly radio address, 'Mann Ki Baat'. He emphasized the country's diverse mango varieties and its growing export market.  The **Agricultural and Processed Food Product Export Development Authority (Apeda)** reported that India exported nearly 29,938.40 tonnes of mangoes worth $56.50 million in FY25 to destinations like the UAE, US, Kuwait, and Qatar. The prime minister also addressed the ongoing heatwave across northern India, urging citizens to stay hydrated and exercise caution.

top_stories.title: More than 700 arrested after riots erupt in France following Paris Saint-Germain’s Champions League triumph | Today News
top_stories.rephrased_article: **French** law enforcement detained 780 individuals following violent clashes that erupted across Paris and several other cities on Saturday night. The unrest, sparked by celebrations after **Paris Saint-Germain's** victory in the Champions League final, resulted in widespread destruction and injuries to police officers.  While most of the celebrations took place peacefully, authorities reported disturbances in 15 cities, with shops vandalized in some areas. **Interior Minister Laurent Nunez** stated that judicial action has been taken against 277 individuals, including minors, who face charges related to assaulting law enforcement, theft, and property damage.  Despite the chaos, official victory celebrations are scheduled for Sunday at the Champ de Mars near the Eiffel Tower, with authorities vowing a firm response to any further disruptions.

top_stories.title: ‘Youngsters will end up following the cockroach’: V-P Radhakrishnan’s sharp warning to media | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Vice President C P Radhakrishnan** warned young people against following "cockroach" trends if the media fails to highlight positive developments. He emphasized the importance of constructive journalism in shaping society and exposing youth to appropriate information. **Radhakrishnan**'s remarks came after the emergence of a satirical social media platform, which gained traction online due to controversy surrounding Chief Justice of India Surya Kant's comments.  He stressed that genuine progress should be recognized over time and called for public discourse to focus on ideas with lasting value.

top_stories.title: Tenant warned civic body, police months before deadly Delhi building collapse: AAP - Delhi News | India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: A three-storey commercial building collapsed in Delhi's Mehrauli, killing at least six people. **AAP** leader Saurabh Bharadwaj alleged that the building had faced repeated complaints about unauthorized construction and safety concerns, but municipal authorities failed to act.  The **MCD**, which has suspended two engineers and registered an FIR against the building owner, is facing accusations of misleading the court and shielding the builder. The rescue operation is ongoing with teams using heavy machinery and sniffer dogs to search for survivors.

top_stories.title: Phase 3 of SIR exercise begins in Odisha, Manipur, Sikkim, Mizoram - India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Election Commission** initiated phase 3 of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in **Odisha**, **Mizoram**, **Sikkim**, and **Manipur**.  Booth Level Officers (BLOs) will conduct house-to-house visits to distribute, collect, and verify enumeration forms. Electors can submit their forms online or through BLOs. The deadline for submitting forms is June 28th, after which eligible voters can apply for registration as a new voter. **The four states** involved account for over 3.67 crore electors.
